Updated app showed session expired; name, payout and phone fields were empty and navigation hidden. Signing back in recovered the same Prime profile and dummy payout. A VM test of the compiled native client exercises revoked-session handling on appStateChange. Clean archived source passed all 41 committed tests and web build; runtime dependency audit found zero vulnerabilities.
sessionExpiryFix.limitations: Native-plugin callbacks are mocked in the regression test; no real native SMS verification is established. The attempted browser viewport override remained 1280 pixels, so no new narrow-phone layout pass is claimed from it. CI Android sample instrumentation passed; its booking screenshot still captured the preceding dashboard and is excluded from listing evidence.
